_comment: Scans that show more than the work: the picture frame, a miniature's case, a mount. Keyed '<folder>/<filename>'. l/t/r/b: percent of the displayed original (after EXIF rotation) cut from the left, top, right and bottom. The original stays the Commons file; shrink-sources, build-tiles and build-data apply the cut (scripts/lib/scan-crops.mjs). Editing an entry makes the cropped works' variants and tiles stale: rerun assets:shrink, assets:build-data and assets:tiles with --only for them. Measured on the 1280 variant and checked by eye on 17 October 2026; Rico approved each from before/after proofs.
